notes.note: Re-reviewed 'Transcript layout tracing' after the fix round: tracing now requires the explicit app:transcript-layout debug namespace only (Developer tools no longer enables it; transcriptLayoutTrace.ts readRequested), records name rows by role plus a one-way FNV hash of the row key and other nodes by test id/tag/classes/ARIA role with no aria-labels (describeTraceNode, traceKey), the overlay is removed on detach, and buffered layout shifts are not re-recorded on re-attach (lastShiftAt). Executed: transcriptLayoutTracer unit tests (namespace-only, privacy, overlay) with fault injection, and the e2e journey that asserts the tracer attaches. Device workflows remain unexercised on hardware.
